system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I need some urgent help with an order I placed. It was accidentally sent to Texas, but I live in Florida, zip code 32286. I don’t remember my order number, but I really need the tracking number for that shipment. Also, I want to return everything in that order except for the pet bed. Can you help me with this?

I can help — first I need to authenticate you so I can look up your orders. Please provide either:

- your email address, or  
- your full name (first and last) so I can use it with the zip code 32286 you already gave.

A few quick notes so you know what I’ll do once I can find your account:
- I will search your recent orders for any shipment sent to Texas and get the tracking number.
- I can only create a return if the order status is "delivered." I’ll check the order status first.
- For the return, you asked to keep the pet bed and return everything else. After I pull the order I’ll list the items and ask you to confirm exactly which item IDs to return before I proceed.
- Refunds must go to the original payment method or to an existing gift card on your account. Which would you prefer if a refund is needed?

Please provide your email or your full name now and I’ll look up your account.

Thank you! My name is Isabella Johansson. I’m not sure which email I used, but my name and zip code should help. For the refund, please send it back to my original payment method.

Let me know if you need any more info from me!
